constitutionalBasis.mandate: Land, that is to say, rights in or over land, land tenures including the relation of landlord and tenant, and the collection of rents; transfer and alienation of agricultural land; land improvement and agricultural loans; colonization.

exemptions.condition: Exempt if agricultural land situated outside municipalities or notified cantonment board areas with population >= 10,000.

registration.jurisdictionRule: Section 28 (document must be presented in the Sub-District where the property is situated)

electronicTransactions.statutoryDeedExclusion: First Schedule, Entry 1 (Excludes conveyance deeds and power of attorney creating interest in immovable property from pure electronic execution without statutory physical registration)

consularNriPoa.mandate: Every instrument executed outside India must be stamped within 3 months after it has been first received in India.

dataProtection.statutoryHoldExemption: Section 17(1)(b) (Exempts processing necessary for compliance with statutory laws, revenue audits, and tax assessments)
dataProtection.aadhaarPolicy: EXCLUDED from MVP Release 1 pursuant to Puttaswamy (2018) and UIDAI circulars

rera.applicabilityThreshold: Projects exceeding 500 sq.m or 8 apartments require registration under Section 3
rera.marketplacePolicy: Informational rural resale directory only; unassisted matching gated pending external High Court counsel opinion
